reason: Glandular hairs are glandular trichomes. 'Without' means they are absent.
Tussocky means growing in tussocks, which is the caespitose habit.
Aristulate means bearing a small awn, so an awn is present. The 'small' is lost, but it is minor.
Hooded is cucullate, so 'not hooded' is not cucullate.
Plain negation of undulate.
Plain negation of flattened.
Domatia are absent.
'Expanding' usually describes growth or unfolding in time, as in 'expanding leaves'. It does not mean dilated. Reject the word.
Bristles are only one kind of trichome. Bristleless does not mean there are no trichomes at all. The target needs 'bristle absent'.
Thickened maps to increased thickness. 'Evenly' only describes how the thickening is distributed.
Perulate means having perulae (bud scales), so they are present.
Isostylous means the styles are all of the same length, so the flower is not heterostylous.
Infertile is sterile.
Squamulose means covered with small scales, which is a kind of scaly.
'Not produced' is a generic phrase, for example 'not produced beyond the apex'. It does not mean not excurrent. Reject the word.
Bigeniculate means bent twice (a twice-kneed awn). 'Bent' loses the 'twice'.
Articulate means jointed, so non-articulate is not jointed.
Crater-like means bowl or cup shaped with a depression.
Bulbiferous means bearing bulbils.
Semilunate means half-moon shaped, which is crescent-shaped.
On leaves, stems and hairs, harsh means rough to the touch, which is scabrous. The constraint is already set.
'Long' is lost. A long awn is more specific than an awn being present. Map to awn present plus a length value, or reject.
Plain negation of recurved.
Palmatinerved means palmate venation, with several primary veins from the base. That is actinodromous.
Well-marked means distinct or conspicuous.
Not apparent means hardly visible, which is inconspicuous.
Tussock-forming is the caespitose habit.
Tiered means arranged in layers or storeys, which is stratified.
Quilted means puckered between the veins, which is bullate.
Tinted purple means purplish. The mapping to purple matches the usual handling of -ish and tinted colours.
Setuliferous means bearing small bristles, which is close to setose.
Bladder-like means inflated.
Not showy means inconspicuous.
Deltate is triangular. 'Broadly' is a degree modifier and is usually dropped.
Negation of resupinate, and the target is already a negated value class.
Semitransparent is partly transparent, which is translucent.
Densely set means crowded.
Striate-veined says the veins form fine parallel lines. 'Striated' alone loses the link to venation. Better 'veins striate' on the vein bearer, or reject.
Asperous means rough, which is scabrous.
Sharply tipped means the tip is pointed.
Same as 'well-marked'.
Rigid maps to inflexible, so the negation is not inflexible.
Plain negation of accrescent.
Rubbery means springy and elastic. This is a loose match for texture.
Aristate means bearing an awn, so 'not aristate' means the awn is absent.
Sclerotic means hardened.
Ampulliform means flask-shaped.
Flocculent means woolly or tufted, which is floccose.
Cap-shaped is dome-like, which is close to domed.
Parallel-nerved means the veins run parallel, which is parallelodromous.
